title: Get the Plane Ready
nutmegSays: Pretend that the plane is taking off over the big blue ocean! Everyone, take your places!

beats.opener: Pretend that the plane is taking off over the big blue ocean! Everyone, take your places!
beats.finale: We landed safely by the beach! Everyone, cheer and give a big wave!

events.line: The control tower is calling! Captain, check the steering wheel and get the plane ready for takeoff!
Bumpy clouds ahead! Captain, hold the steering wheel tight and steer the plane around them!
events.calmAgain: Phew, the sky is smooth again.

events.line: We're flying over the ocean! Captain, tell everyone what you can see down below and where we're going next!
Passenger, you can't find your seat! Captain, help the Passenger find a good airplane seat for the trip!
Uh-oh, Passenger, your things are rolling around! Gather them up and keep them safe before the plane turns!
events.calmAgain: Phew, everything is put away again.

events.line: The passengers are hungry! Flight Attendant, roll the snack cart down the aisle and serve everyone a snack!
Oh no, a red light is blinking! Co-Pilot, check the map for a safe way, and Flight Attendant, help everyone stay in their seats!
events.calmAgain: Phew, the red light turned off.

events.line: We need a new way to the beach! Co-Pilot, look at the travel cut-outs and help plan where the plane goes next!
Oops, the snack kitchen is a mess! Snack Chef, sort the snacks and get the new orders ready fast!
events.calmAgain: Phew, the snack kitchen is tidy again.

events.line: VIP Passenger, order something fancy from the snack menu! Snack Chef, make it extra special!
Uh-oh, VIP Passenger, the cabin is getting wobbly! Make everything around your seat secure and hold on!
events.calmAgain: Phew, the cabin is steady again.

events.line: Passenger and VIP Passenger, it's shopping time in the sky! Use your Sky Dollars to buy treats from the snack menu!
